Kuro TV - 1.5 beta (take 8)
===========================

File      : Kuro-tv-beta-1.5.apk
Size      : 48,494,449 bytes
sha256    : 4f51836533dc843ff201ddf28e088d165660cf933128c3a6ced7ddfb8d15fb6d
md5       : a8e28cda25e275091a6fa248734dbf5b
version   : 1.5-beta  (versionCode 92 - unchanged)
signing   : v2, CN=Kuro Anime  (same key as 1.0-1.4)
Delivery  : Google Drive only. NOT on GitHub, no tag, no release.

Install
-------
Straight over take 7. No uninstall, data, theme and settings kept.

New: an update button that is actually there
--------------------------------------------
Two ways in, both one tap:

  * the round arrow icon in the header, left of "Log in", on every screen
  * the "Keep Kuro current" card at the top of Account, with
    "Check for updates" and "Update settings"

One tap checks now. If a newer release exists it downloads in the background,
verifies it, and hands it to Android's installer - you never leave the app to
find the file. Android still asks before installing (that prompt cannot be
skipped by any app), and automatic checks/downloads keep following your
existing Kuro updates settings.

Right now the updater reads GitHub's latest release, which is 1.4 - older than
this beta - so it will correctly tell you that you are already ahead. It starts
working the moment a newer release is published.

New: four more themes, and a richer surface
-------------------------------------------
The picker went from ten accents to fourteen:

  Signature   teal    violet   graphite
  Cool        sky     royal    indigo   emerald   lime
  Warm        citron  amber    sunset   rose      crimson   magenta

  new: royal (#805be7)  lime (#8fe444)  citron (#e2e756)  rose (#e968a9)

They are generated from the same palette tool as the original ten, so the ten
you already had are byte-for-byte unchanged - nothing you liked moved.

"Richer" here is depth, not decoration: the backdrop carries an accent-tinted
glow in every theme, the header is glass with a top highlight, posters and
cards sit on a hairline plus a real shadow, primary buttons are lit from above
and cast an accent-tinted shadow, panels and the dock get top-light gradients,
and the picker's current tile and preview card get a glow and a gradient ring.
One layer, no colours of its own, so it follows all fourteen accents and both
light and dark. Blur is deliberately light - a heavy blur over scroll-linked
motion is what makes a WebView stutter.

Gone: the Motion - Beta card
----------------------------
The "Motion - Beta" card and its "Play the reel" video player are removed from
both files and from the UI. The motion itself stays exactly as it was: the
opening film, the press spring on every control, no tap ripple, the Home banner
still gone, and the scroll-linked movement.

Still from earlier takes
------------------------
  * Settings > Developer opens the Discord profile, deep-linked into the app
  * scrolling is scroll-linked like the reel (rails, grids, banners, headers)
  * the tap ripple / water droplets are gone
  * the "One library - Twelve connected sources" card is gone

Known
-----
Nothing opens a browser or a store; the update path is shell-side, so it works
even with no page loaded. Because it reuses the existing updater, its state is
the one you see in Settings > Kuro updates.
